prompts.optimized:
ON-SET CHARACTER REFERENCE WALL — 老王 (Lao Wang)

This is a behind-the-scenes character reference board from the set of a Chinese urban drama. A still photographer shot these reference photos on 35mm Kodak film during pre-production for the hair, makeup, and wardrobe departments.

CHARACTER: 老王, male, mid-40s, about 172cm, stocky with a round face and double chin.
FACE: Round friendly face, wearing black-frame glasses, eyes crinkling into slits when he smiles — the kind of man who is always quick to offer help. Weathered skin from years of outdoor work.
WARDROBE: Workwear jacket over dark trousers — like he just came off a construction site. No fashion, just utility. The clothes of a man who works with his hands and doesn't think about clothes.

BOARD LAYOUT:
- One main full-body portrait (standing, weight shifted to one leg, hands in jacket pockets, easy grin)
- A row of 4-5 smaller full-body reference shots from different angles
- A row of 5-6 headshot studies — the round face, glasses, double chin, warm crinkled-eyes smile — must be consistent across all
- One emotional portrait: laughing with mouth open, head thrown back — a man who finds life's absurdities funny
- A small section showing wardrobe laid flat: the workwear jacket, the dark trousers, the worn work boots
- Minimal handwritten-style notes in margins (character name, keyword: "热心") — NOT typeset

The entire board should look like physical photographs pinned or taped to a neutral grey wall in a production office — slightly messy, overlapping edges, pushpin marks, organic arrangement. NOT a designed layout, NOT a catalog spread.

ABSOLUTE STYLE REQUIREMENTS - READ CAREFULLY:
This image MUST look like raw, unretouched photographs taken by an on-set still photographer during the actual shooting of a live-action feature film.
It must NOT look like: a fashion catalog, a lookbook, an e-commerce product page, a clothing brand advertisement, a Zara/Uniqlo product shot, a stock photo, a CG render, a 3D model, a digital painting, an anime cel, an AI-generated plastic-smooth image, or any form of commercial product photography.

CRITICAL VISUAL QUALITIES:
- Shot on 35mm Kodak 5219 film stock with natural halation and organic grain structure
- Anamorphic lens with subtle breathing, vignetting, and real optical imperfections
- Available light / practical lighting only — NO studio softbox perfection, NO ring light catchlights
- Real human skin with visible pores, fine lines, natural unevenness, subtle blemishes
- Hair with flyaways, split ends, natural frizz — NOT helmet-like or airbrushed smooth
- Fabrics with real wrinkles, natural drape, worn-in texture — NOT pressed and perfect
- Colors should be slightly desaturated like real film, NOT hyper-vibrant
- Slight depth of field and natural bokeh where appropriate
- The overall look should be GRITTY and RAW, like production stills pinned to a wall on a real film set
- Shadows should be real and sometimes harsh — NOT perfectly filled and balanced
- The layout should feel like a physical mood board on a studio wall, NOT a designed graphic design spread
- NO clean sans-serif typography overlays, NO product codes, NO size charts, NO price tags, NO brand logos
- This is a FILM PRODUCTION reference, NOT a commercial product display

If the result looks like it could appear in a fashion magazine or online store, it has FAILED.
The only acceptable aesthetic is: behind-the-scenes photographs from a real movie set, shot on film, pinned to a cork board with pushpins.
